title: Mycelium cancellation acknowledgement v1
description: Successful cancellation reply. Excludes new attempts and assignments after acknowledgement; an already assigned attempt may still begin before the next worker check. Consumers needing execution exclusion wait for confirmed release. Expired coverage is not consumer completion.

will_not_run.description: No new attempt is created or assigned after the acknowledgement. An attempt assigned earlier may still begin briefly and is stopped at its next worker check. Release stays pending until proven; consumers needing exclusion wait for confirmed.

release.description: Aggregate release across every known attempt of the job, regardless of queued, active, terminal or removed state: not_applicable only if there was never an attempt; pending while any known attempt release is unproven, retaining its charge; confirmed once every known attempt is proven released. A requeued lost attempt remains pending until exact release proof. Null means historical coverage cannot be established from an expired digest marker. Cancellation never creates release custody or placement blockers. Fresh rejoin confirms copies only from the immediately previous session (PreviousSession matching the recorded old session); older sessions remain unresolved. For imported pre-S03 state, a non-current copy without retained runtime custody counts as released with diagnostic legacy_no_retained_custody; retained legacy custody remains pending until normal release proof.

acknowledged_at.description: Stored first cancellation time (Job.cancelled_at or the reservation cancellation time), echoed unchanged on retries and after reservation binding, in UTC RFC3339. Null for an expired digest marker whose original timestamp is no longer retained.
